paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens, comparing a baseline model (Mistralv0.2-Base) with versions of the same model further fine-tuned on different clinical specialty datasets, with results shown per token specialty category. The horizontal axis contains the category groups labeled “Cardio,” “Gastro,” “Infect,” “Neuro,” “Obstetrics,” and “Pediatrics” (ordered left to right as listed) under the axis label “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear numeric scale spanning approximately −27 at the bottom to −22 at the top, with regularly spaced tick labels at 1-unit intervals (−22, −23, −24, −25, −26, −27). Each category group contains a clustered set of seven vertical bars: one light-blue bar for the baseline “Mistralv0.2-Base,” plus six bars in progressively darker beige-to-brown hues corresponding to the specialty used for fine-tuning (legend labeled “Fine-tuned on: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics”); within each group the bars are placed side-by-side with consistent spacing and no stacking. Approximate bar endpoints (negative log-probabilities) by group are: for Cardio terms, baseline ≈ −26.7 and fine-tuned bars around ≈ −25.7 to −26.1; for Gastro terms, baseline ≈ −24.8 and fine-tuned bars around ≈ −23.9 to −24.3; for Infect terms, baseline ≈ −23.7 and fine-tuned bars around ≈ −22.9 to −23.3; for Neuro terms, baseline ≈ −25.4 and fine-tuned bars around ≈ −24.2 to −24.7; for Obstetrics terms, baseline ≈ −24.7 and fine-tuned bars around ≈ −23.8 to −24.0; and for Pediatrics terms, baseline ≈ −24.7 and fine-tuned bars around ≈ −23.5 to −24.0. The categories are not presented as a sorted ranking by value, and no individual bars appear visually emphasized with outlines, annotations, or distinct markings beyond the color legend.
